\begin{abstract}

Large Language Model (LLM) based Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) methods now match or exceed encoder baselines in extraction accuracy, yet they produce bare relation triplets without identifying the sentences that support each prediction.
In deployment contexts such as clinical knowledge bases and legal due-diligence systems, users cannot verify predictions without manually locating textual evidence across multi-page documents.
Encoder-based evidence methods (SAIS, DREEAM) can produce supporting sentences but trail LLM approaches in accuracy. The community therefore faces a gap between extractive precision and output verifiability.

We formalize evidence-grounded DocRE as a structured generation task and conduct a systematic comparison of three post-training optimization paradigms: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning (RSFT).
Our study spans 85+ experimental configurations across four model scales (1.7B to 8B parameters), two model families, and two datasets.
We introduce the Evidence-Decoupling Ratio (EDCR) diagnostic and a Contrastive Evidence Discrimination (CED) scoring function for sample selection.

Three findings emerge.
First, RL optimization pressure correlates with evidence-extraction decoupling severity: GRPO causes catastrophic decoupling, DPO shows gradual degradation, and RSFT preserves stable joint performance.
Second, the cost of evidence production is scale-dependent and non-monotonic: at 1.7B parameters evidence provides a +8pp Ign-F1 benefit, at 4B it imposes a $-$7.5pp penalty, and at 8B the cost approaches zero.
Third, RSFT with CED scoring is the only effective route: it achieves +4.92pp Ign-F1 over supervised fine-tuning at 4B scale, and our 1.7B RSFT model (50.50 Ign-F1) matches 8B SFT performance (50.51).

\end{abstract}

\section{Related Work}
\label{sec:related_work}

Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) requires reasoning across sentence boundaries to identify relations between entity pairs.
DocRED \citep{yao2019docred} established the first large-scale benchmark for this task, catalyzing a line of encoder-based methods that treat DocRE as classification over entity pair representations.
ATLOP \citep{zhou2021atlop} introduced adaptive thresholding for multi-label prediction, and KD-DocRE \citep{tan2022kddocre} applied knowledge distillation to bridge the teacher-student performance gap.
A parallel thread incorporates sentence-level evidence into these architectures.
SAIS \citep{xiao2022sais} introduced evidence supervision as an auxiliary training signal and showed that joint evidence prediction improves extraction through data augmentation and ensemble inference.
DREEAM \citep{ma2023dreeam} extended this approach with dynamic memory-based evidence retrieval that guides attention to supporting sentences.
EIDER \citep{xie2022eider} jointly trains an evidence extractor and fuses evidence representations into the relation classifier.
In all three systems, evidence identification is binary sentence classification over a fixed candidate set, a formulation that adds no output complexity.
Recent work has recast DocRE for large language models.
\citet{wan2024genres} reformulate extraction as constrained generation with entity-aware decoding.
\citet{xu2024lmrc} frame it as multi-choice reading comprehension, which restricts outputs to predefined options and reduces the generation burden.
\citet{chen2025docksrag} combine retrieval-augmented generation with structured knowledge to ground predictions in document context.
AutoRE \citep{autore2024} introduces a relation-head-facts decomposition that fine-tunes LLMs with QLoRA for end-to-end DocRE.
These methods match or surpass encoder baselines in extraction accuracy but produce bare triplets without evidence.
The critical distinction between encoder and generative evidence lies in their computational nature.
In SAIS and DREEAM, evidence retrieval is a classification task that regularizes the encoder and improves extraction without increasing output length.
In LLM-based DocRE, evidence production requires additional output tokens for each predicted triple, and this generation burden competes with the extraction objective for model capacity.
This asymmetry explains why evidence ``helps'' in encoder methods but can ``hurt'' in generative ones: the two paradigms operate on fundamentally different forms of evidence integration.

Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), introduced by \citet{shao2024deepseekmath}, computes advantages within groups of sampled outputs to eliminate the need for a separate value network.
Recent applications have extended GRPO to structured information extraction: E-GRPO \citep{zhao2025egrpo} incorporates entity-aware rewards for named entity recognition, and R1-RE \citep{dai2025r1re} applies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to relation extraction.
Direct Preference Optimization \citep{rafailov2023direct} reformulates RLHF as implicit reward maximization through preference pairs, without explicit reward models.
Recent analyses argue that RL fine-tuning does not cause catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge \citep{jin2025rl_panacea}.
Our findings are compatible with this conclusion but address a distinct phenomenon.
The decoupling we observe is an intra-task multi-objective trade-off where extraction and evidence generation compete for model capacity within a single task, rather than knowledge loss across separate tasks.
The mild decoupling under bf16 GRPO confirms this interpretation: the model retains its extraction capability but shifts resource allocation under evidence reward pressure.
Reward overoptimization, where proxy reward scores increase while true performance degrades, is a known risk in RLHF \citep{gao2023scaling}.
Constrained RLHF has been proposed to mitigate this effect in multi-objective settings \citep{moskovitz2024constrained}.
Our decoupling spectrum represents a new instance of intra-task reward overoptimization, where evidence rewards crowd out extraction quality.
QLoRA compounds this problem: the quantized parameter space constrains effective capacity, and the divergence between quantized and full-precision actors grows over extended training, which amplifies the underlying multi-objective conflict.

\citet{zelikman2022star} introduced STaR, an iterative self-improvement method that trains language models on their own correct outputs and bootstraps with rationale augmentation for initially incorrect problems.
Subsequent work has extended this framework to mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following.
Our RSFT procedure is a single-round variant: the model samples multiple candidate outputs per input, a quality filter selects the best response, and the model trains on the filtered set without iteration.
The contribution of RSFT in our setting is not the self-training framework, which is well-established, but its application to evidence-grounded DocRE with CED/NLI scoring as a domain-specific quality filter.
This application reveals a structural advantage of discrete output selection over gradient-based optimization for multi-output tasks.
Because RSFT selects complete outputs rather than differentiating through a reward signal, it cannot exploit the extraction-evidence trade-off that GRPO and DPO discover through gradient updates.
The filtering mechanism inherently preserves joint quality: it retains outputs that are simultaneously good at extraction and evidence production, rather than allowing one objective to dominate the other.

\section{Limitations}

All main experiments report results on the DocRED development set. Our CodaLab test set submission is pending. While dev-set tuning may overestimate absolute performance, the relative comparisons across methods (the decoupling spectrum pattern and evidence tax analysis) remain valid, as all systems are evaluated under identical conditions.

Exact-match F1, our primary metric, penalizes valid but surface-form-different entity mentions, as noted by \citet{wan2024genres}. This affects all methods equally and preserves relative comparisons, but absolute Ign-F1 numbers likely underestimate the true capability of LLM-based relation extraction.

Our per-relation EDCR analysis relies on automatic metrics. Method-level EDCR correlates strongly with Rel-F1 ($\rho{=}{-}0.965$), but a human annotation study would further validate the diagnostic value of per-relation EDCR scores.

We evaluate one algorithm per RL family: GRPO for online RL and DPO for offline preference optimization. Other algorithms (PPO, KTO) may yield different results. However, the core insight of the decoupling spectrum, that stronger gradient-based optimization pressure leads to more severe evidence decoupling, likely generalizes across algorithms within each family.

---
name: paper-refinement
description: Step 5 论文迭代修改循环——Reviewer 评分循环 + 收敛判断 + paper_checklist 注入，max 5 轮。Paper Agent 进入 Step 5 时 Read 本 skill。
scope: global
tags:
  - workflow
  - research
  - writing
  - academic
  - review
version: 1
roles:
  - paper_agent
---

# Step 5 — Iterative Refinement

Step 4 全部章节落盘后，Paper Agent 进入 Step 5：把全文递交 Reviewer 评分，按反馈修改，直到收敛。

**核心约束**：
- 串行——一轮 Reviewer 返回结果处理完才进下一轮，禁止并发请求
- 评分驱动——overall 提升才 accept 本轮，下降则 git revert
- 上限 5 轮——硬约束，达到上限即停，不论分数

## 状态记录（git 是 truth source）

每轮修改前 commit 当前论文目录，作为 revert 锚点。无需额外 state 文件。

```
git -C projects/{project} add paper/
git -C projects/{project} commit -m "[paper] refinement round {N-1}"
```

Round N 的 commit message 用 `N-1`，即 round 1 修改前 commit `round 0`（Step 4 落盘后的初稿）。

## 单轮流程

```
Round N（N = 1..5）：

1. git commit 当前版本（message: "[paper] refinement round N-1"）
   └── 落地评分下降时的 revert 锚点

2. 组装审查请求：
   - read_project_file("paper_checklist.yaml") — 用户自定义必查项
   - 拼 LaTeX 全文（或 Patch 模式下的差异）+ writing_plan.yaml 路径
   - 末尾追加 "## 用户自定义必查项"（见下方"checklist 注入格式"）

3. paper_agent_request_review(text=组装后的请求, project=...)
   └── Reviewer 通过 reviewer_post_to_director 回传评分

4. 解析 Reviewer 响应：
   - 维度分（Originality/Clarity/Soundness/Significance/Presentation，1-4）
   - overall（1-10）
   - 各条具体问题 severity（critical/warning/info）
   - checklist 项 PASS/FAIL
   ★ 任一 checklist FAIL → 该条问题 severity 自动按 critical 对待

5. 按问题类型分流处理：
   - 事实性错误（数字不一致 / 引用错位）→ 自己用 edit_paper_section 改
   - 段落级叙事问题（逻辑断裂 / 强度词超限）→ spawn Worker 重写段落，回来再 edit_paper_section
   - 结构问题（章节顺序 / 段落归并）→ 自己用 edit_paper_section
   - critical 且 claim 本身无支撑 → 汇报 Director（不要自行降 claim）

6. 全部问题处理完后判断本轮 overall 走势：
   - overall(N) ≥ overall(N-1) → 保留本轮修改，进入收敛判断
   - overall(N) <  overall(N-1) → git checkout 上一轮 commit，回退本轮所有修改，标记"本轮无进展"

7. 收敛判断（任一满足即停）：
   - 全部问题为 info（无 critical / warning）
   - N == 5（硬上限）
   - 连续两轮 overall 持平（差 ≤0.1）
   - 连续两轮无新增 critical（critical 列表内容相同或更短）

   未收敛且 N<5 → 进入 Round N+1
   已收敛 → 进入收尾（见下文）
```

## checklist 注入格式

`read_project_file("paper_checklist.yaml")` 拿到 items 后，在审查请求末尾追加：

```
## 用户自定义必查项
以下是用户指定的必须检查的项，每项必须明确标注 PASS 或 FAIL：
- [chk_001] {text}
- [chk_002] {text}
...

如果任何一项标注为 FAIL，整体 severity 自动提升为 critical（必须打回修改）。
```

- checklist 为空 / 文件不存在 → 不追加该段，正常请求
- 不要重写 checklist 文本——保持用户原话，让 Reviewer 自己定位
- Dream 模式禁止注入（Dream 论文不投，格式检查无意义）

## 修改 Worker 任务模板

段落级修改派 Worker（不是整章重写）时：

```
spawn_worker(
  task_type="paper_writing",
  project=...,
  task_prompt="""
Reviewer 在 {section} 章发现以下问题，需要你修改对应段落：

【问题位置】{paragraph_id / 行号}
【问题描述】{Reviewer 原文}
【建议方向】{Reviewer 给的方向}

当前段落原文：
```latex
{原文片段}
```

参考资料：
- 写作规范：Read skills/global/latex-paper.skill.md + red-section.skill.md
- registry 切片：{相关 exp_id 列表}
- 同章节已有内容：{section}.tex 整章
- 引用：references.bib（只用已 verified 条目，未验证标 [UNVERIFIED]）

要求：
- 只改问题段落，不动其他内容
- 输出修改后的段落 latex（标记 old / new）
- 不要画图、不要补实验
- 改完即返回，不写额外说明
"""
)
```

Worker 返回后 Paper Agent 用 `edit_paper_section(project, section, old_text=..., new_text=..., claims=..., table_cells=..., figures=...)` 落盘——`edit_paper_section` 自动同步 provenance，不会 deprecate 未触及的 claim。

## 收敛后收尾（Step 5e）

Reviewer 评分循环收敛后**必须执行完整三件套**——视觉 + 引用 + 溯源**全部跑完**再汇报 Director；不允许只跑一两项就提交。任一发现 critical/blocker 都要在汇报中显式列出，不得"建议提交审稿"压过失败信号。

按下面顺序串行（每一步完成才进下一步，前一步失败不绕过）：

```
1. paper-visual-review 排版检查
   └── Read skills/global/paper-visual-review.skill.md
   └── pdf_to_images(pdf_path=projects/{project}/paper/main.pdf, pages="1-N", dpi=200)
       逐页检查图表分辨率 / 字号 / 边距溢出 / 公式 / 引用编号 / 缺失引用占位 [?]
   └── cleanup_pdf_images(output_dir=<上一步返回的 output_dir>)  # 不留临时文件
   └── 收集 findings：[{page, severity, issue}]
   └── 出现 critical（图表溢出 / 缺失编号 / 公式乱码）→ 记入 visual_report，**不**立即返工，
       与 verify_references / check_provenance_completeness 的结果**一并汇报 Director**

2. verify_references 最终引用验证
   └── verify_references(paper_dir="projects/{project}/paper", project=..., skip_online=False)
   └── 返回字段：status (ok/orphan_bib/missing_bib/not_found/mismatch) 按条聚合
   └── critical 阈值：
        - missing_bib（正文 \cite 但 .bib 缺）→ 必须修，否则 LaTeX 编译失败
        - not_found（OpenAlex 找不到）→ 疑似幻觉引用，自己 WebSearch 二次验证；仍找不到 → critical
        - mismatch（年份/作者偏差）→ warning
   └── 自己能改的小问题（missing_bib、年份） → edit_paper_section 修；改完**再调一次 verify_references** 确认通过

3. check_provenance_completeness 溯源覆盖

   └── 返回：tier_distribution / untracked_numbers / invalidated_claims

        - untracked_numbers（正文出现但 provenance 没追踪的数字）≥ 5 → warning：派 Worker 补 provenance
```

### 汇报 Director 模板

三件套全部跑完后**统一**汇报（不要分三次发），把所有 critical/warning 列在一处便于 Director 决策：

```

  text="[写作进展] Step 5 收尾完成
         迭代轮数：{N}/5
         最终 overall：{score}
         checklist：全部 PASS / 还有 X 条 FAIL（已修复 / 待 Director 决策）

         ===== 视觉检查 =====
         检查页数：{n}/{total}
         结论：PASS / 发现 X 条 critical + Y 条 warning
         {若有 critical：逐条列出 page + 描述}

         ===== 引用验证 =====
         总数 X 条，已验证 Y 条
         critical：missing_bib X 条 + 疑似幻觉 Y 条（已尝试 WebSearch 二次验证 → 结果）
         warning：mismatch X 条
         {若有 critical：列出条目 + 已采取的修复}

         ===== Provenance 覆盖 =====
         Tier 分布：T1 {a}% / T2 {b}% / T3 {c}% / TX {d}%
         {若 T3 > 30% 或 TX ≥ 1：列出受影响的 claim/figure/table}
         未追踪数字：X 个（详见 untracked_numbers）

         ===== 建议 =====
         {以下任选其一}
         A. 视觉/引用/provenance 全部 PASS → 建议提交审稿（submit_paper_to_review）
         B. 存在 critical → 请 Director 决策：{具体问题列表 + 建议修复方向}
         C. provenance 红线触发 → 请 Director 决定：补实验 / 改 claim / 接受现状",
  project=...
)
```

Director 决定是否调 `submit_paper_to_review`——Paper Agent **不**主动调，这是 Director 的权限。

### 红线（Step 5e 不可绕过）

1. **三件套必须全跑**：跳过任一项直接汇报 = 违规，被 Director 打回时不接受"我以为不必要"

1	---
2	name: paper-quality-lessons
3	description: NeurIPS 投稿实战经验总结——人工审查中提炼的写作规范、审查清单、常见反模式。Paper Agent / Reviewer / Director 写论文或审查论文时加载。
4	allowed-tools: [Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep]
5	scope: global
6	version: 1
7	tags:
8	  - writing
9	  - paper
10	  - quality
11	  - checklist
12	  - review
13	roles:
14	  - agent
15	  - reviewer
16	  - director
17	  - paper_agent
18	---
19	
20	# 论文写作质量指南（NeurIPS 实战经验）
21	
22	> 来源：2026 年 NeurIPS 投稿期间，从 20+ 项目的人工审查反馈中提炼。
23	> 每条规则都源自真实的 bug / 退回 / 审稿质疑。
24	
25	---
26	
27	## 一、数据诚信与溯源（最高优先级）
28	
29	### 1.1 数字必须有源头
30	
31	- 论文中**每一个数字**必须可追溯到 registry 实验 ID 或原始结果文件
32	- 禁止凭记忆写数字——必须 `cat result.json | head` + `ls -la` 附上文件证据
33	- 计算值（均值、标准差、DID、delta）必须独立重算，不信 Agent 第一手汇报
34	- `paper_provenance.yaml` 覆盖率必须 100%，改数字必须同步更新 provenance
35	
36	> **教训（D149 事件）**：Agent 曾伪造完整的 metrics 数据包括 p-value，事后被 Reviewer 独立 parse JSON 抓出。从此所有关键数据必须 Reviewer 独立验证到字段级别。
37	
38	### 1.2 不同来源数据不能混用
39	
40	- 配对数据必须同 seed、同 c 值、同 N、同 evaluation protocol
41	- 两张表如果 protocol 不同（如 0-shot vs 8-shot），论文必须明确说明
42	- 跨 config 比较 delta 会引入系统误差——必须补跑同 config baseline 后才能比较
43	- 非等量对比必须显式标注（如 "at unmatched volumes"）
44	
45	> **教训（D027 事件）**：不同 config 文件的 baseline 不同，跨 config 比较 delta 值引入了 artifact。
46	
47	### 1.3 结论撤回后不可复活
48	
49	- 被 Director shelved 的数据（如因截断混淆），禁止重新引入论文
50	- `paper_provenance.yaml` 中 `verified: false` 的 claim，不得恢复
51	- 术语修正后不可回退（如 "same norm" → "same per-layer standard deviation"）
52	
53	---
54	
55	## 二、Claim 强度与数据匹配
56	
57	### 2.1 Claim 强度规则
58	
59	| 数据支撑 | 允许的最强表述 |
60	|----------|--------------|
61	| 单 seed, 单数据集 | "preliminary observation", "initial evidence" |
62	| 单 seed, 多数据集 | "suggestive pattern", "indicative trend" |
63	| 多 seed, 单数据集 | 报告均值±标准差，可写 "we find" |
64	| 多 seed, 多数据集 | 可用 "robust", "consistent" |
65	| 统计检验显著 | 可用 "significant", 附 p-value |
66	| 单 seed + 外推到其他条件 | 必须加限定，不能声称 "scale-invariant" 等 |
67	
68	### 2.2 禁止的过强表述
69	
70	- "remarkably stable" → 改为 "relatively stable" 或给出量化波动范围
71	- "confirmed" → 仅 "suggestive" 级别数据不能用
72	- "scale-invariant" → single-seed 验证不够
73	- "We attribute X to Y" → 如果是假说，必须改为 "We hypothesize" + "requiring causal verification"
74	- "roughly twice" → 实际比值必须在 1.8x-2.2x 才能用，否则改为更准确的近似
75	- "domain-agnostic" → 改为 "robust across N domains tested"
76	
77	### 2.3 Claim 降级机制
78	
79	当证据不足以支撑独立 claim 时，应降级为 discussion 中的定性讨论，而非删除。具体做法：
80	- 独立 contribution → Discussion 段落
81	- 硬 claim → 加 caveat 的软 claim
82	- 正文数字 → 移入 Appendix
83	
84	---
85	
86	## 三、叙事与 Storytelling
87	
88	### 3.1 结构原则
89	
90	- 核心 paradox/发现之间必须有**过渡句**桥接，不能让读者在关键处断线
91	- Introduction 每条 Contribution 必须有对应的 section/table 支撑
92	- Discussion 不应重复 Results 的具体数字——引用表格编号
93	- 同一解释不要在多处重复推导——主文写一次 + 指向 Appendix
94	- Limitations 段不要写成一个 17 行大段——拆分为 2-3 个子段按主题分组
95	
96	### 3.2 冷引用（Cold Reference）
97	
98	- 任何首次出现的概念必须有上文铺垫
99	- Introduction 贡献列表中不能突然出现未被提及的模型/方法名
100	
101	### 3.3 不要用旧叙事套新数字
102	
103	新 baseline 出来后若 delta 大幅变化，Section 的叙事逻辑必须重写，不是简单替换数字。
104	
105	### 3.4 Contingency Plan
106	
107	关键实验结果不确定时需预写两套叙事（如 "若结果 A → 叙事 A"、"若结果 B → 叙事 B"），实验完成后选择正确版本。提交前必须确认只留了一套。
108	
109	### 3.5 不要基于中间值做叙事决策
110	
111	70% 进度时的估计往往不够稳定（尤其 GSM8K 等难度分布不均匀的 benchmark），必须等完整数据再定稿叙事。
112	
113	---
114	
115	## 四、术语与一致性
116	
117	### 4.1 术语一致性
118	
119	- 全文必须统一使用正式定义的术语，不得出现同义词漂移
120	- 术语定义后，每次使用必须完全一致（不要有时 "perturbation sensitivity" 有时 "perturbation impact"）
121	
122	### 4.2 统计量一致性
123	
124	- 两个不同的 kappa/p-value 每次出现时必须标注是哪个
125	- 同一个 metric 在不同位置的数字必须完全一致
126	- 修改任何数字后必须全文 grep 确认所有引用处同步
127	
128	### 4.3 p-value 格式
129	
130	- 无前导零、3 位小数：`p = .003`（不是 `p = 0.003`）
131	- 当非劣效性 p<0.001 实际由正向效应驱动时，必须加括注说明
132	
133	### 4.4 例子与定义必须一致
134	
135	Taxonomy 中的定义和对应示例不能自相矛盾。如果定义说 "no new content"，示例中就不能包含新信息。
136	
137	---
138	
139	## 五、投稿前检查清单（Pre-Submission Checklist）
140	
141	### 5.1 占位符扫描（硬门禁）
142	
143	提交前必须 grep 扫描，以下模式要求**零匹配**：
144	```
145	XX.XX, PLACEHOLDER, [If , TODO, TBD, \placeholder{
146	```
147	所有条件占位段落（`[If ...]`）必须替换为最终文本。
148	
149	### 5.2 编译检查
150	
151	- [ ] 编译零 error
152	- [ ] 无 `??` 未解析引用
153	- [ ] 无 > 1pt 的 overfull hbox
154	- [ ] 正文 ≤ 9 页（NeurIPS desk reject 风险）
155	- [ ] 使用当年 style file（`neurips_2026.sty`）
156	- [ ] Review 版启用行号
157	- [ ] 匿名审稿版无作者姓名、无致谢
158	
159	### 5.3 数据完整性
160	
161	- [ ] 论文所有数字与 registry/provenance 交叉验证通过
162	- [ ] 计算值（均值、标准差、DID、delta）独立重算确认
163	- [ ] 所有 evaluation protocol 差异已在论文中说明
164	- [ ] 多 seed 结果报告均值和标准差
165	- [ ] 单 seed 数据在 Limitations 中声明
166	
167	### 5.4 图表检查
168	
169	- [ ] 所有 figure PDF 存在且路径匹配
170	- [ ] 图表不超栏宽（单栏 5.5in / 全宽 6.5in）
171	- [ ] 图中字体 ≥ 7pt
172	- [ ] 小数精度全表统一
173	- [ ] 最优结果加粗、次优下划线
174	- [ ] 表格标题（caption）自包含
175	- [ ] Forest plot 等可视化无 dummy 值（CI_LO=-99 等）
176	
177	### 5.5 引用检查
178	
179	- [ ] 引用覆盖：**直接相关方法、baseline 论文、评测 benchmark 论文、理论基础**（任一缺失说明调研不充分）
180	- [ ] 引用密度与目标会议近年录用论文同量级
181	- [ ] 引用键与 bib 条目 1:1 匹配
182	- [ ] 无孤儿 bib 条目
183	- [ ] 无幻觉引用（所有被引论文实际存在）
184	- [ ] 近年论文的年份/会议准确
185	- [ ] 审稿人要求的引用全部补齐
186	
187	### 5.6 匿名化检查
188	
189	- [ ] 源代码无硬编码绝对路径（`/Users/...`, `/root/...`）
190	- [ ] 配置文件无服务器路径
191	- [ ] Git history 已清理 author 信息（用 fresh repo）
192	- [ ] 项目管理文件不得提交（AGENTS.md, memory.md, registry.yaml, task_context/ 等）
193	- [ ] API Keys 通过环境变量，无泄露
194	
195	### 5.7 会议 Checklist 填写（如目标会议要求）
196	
197	- [ ] Claims: 摘要/Introduction 准确反映实验范围
198	- [ ] Limitations: 正文 Limitations 段 + Appendix 补充
199	- [ ] Experiments: 实验设置完整（exp_id, seed, 超参, 评估 protocol）
200	- [ ] Reproducibility: 数据集公开、代码可用
201	- [ ] Statistical Significance: 多 seed 均值+标准差、置信区间
202	- [ ] Compute: GPU 型号、训练时间、总 GPU-hours
203	- [ ] Licenses: 数据集/模型引用完整
204	- [ ] AI Assistants: 如实声明使用情况
205	- [ ] 每项认真回答（不要全写 N/A）
206	
207	### 5.8 叙事完整性
208	
209	- [ ] Conclusion 包含所有关键限定符（如 "under greedy decoding"）
210	- [ ] Abstract 与正文一致（不能一个写 "single seed" 另一个已是 "10 seeds"）
211	- [ ] 无 Appendix Version A/B 两套叙事残留
212	- [ ] 无 LaTeX 注释与正文混淆
213	- [ ] Contribution claim 在 Introduction 中（不在 Related Work 中）
214	- [ ] 所有专有名词/缩写首次出现时有定义（Abstract 内缩写也必须展开）
215	- [ ] Introduction 与 Method/Results 讲同一条主线（idea 变化后全文逻辑一致）
216	
217	### 5.9 去 AI 风格检查
218	
219	- [ ] **`grep "—" paper/*.tex` 全文清零**（解释性 em-dash 必须全删，最显著的 AI 痕迹）
220	- [ ] **`grep " – " paper/*.tex` 全文清零**（解释性 en-dash 必须全删）
221	- [ ] 无 "-ing," 分词短语结尾（如 "..., demonstrating the effectiveness of..."）
222	- [ ] 无连续 "Furthermore" / "Moreover" / "Additionally"（同段最多 1 个）
223	- [ ] 无 "It is worth noting that..." / "Notably, ..."
224	- [ ] 无 "delve into" / "leverage" / "utilize" / "a myriad of" / "a plethora of"
225	- [ ] 自然段 5-8 句是正常的，不要每 2-3 句就换段
226	
227	### 5.10 模板与同类论文核对
228	
229	- [ ] LaTeX 模板从目标会议官网下载（不是他人转载、不是上一年）
230	- [ ] `\documentclass[]{}` 选项匹配 review / camera-ready 阶段
231	- [ ] 写作前已参考 2-3 篇同领域近 1-2 年优秀论文，叙事节奏对齐
232	
233	---
234	
235	## 六、Reviewer 审查标准
236	
237	### 6.1 CRITICAL 级别（必须修复才能提交）
238	
239	- 论文数字与实验数据不一致
240	- Abstract 与正文矛盾
241	- Evaluation protocol 混淆（如 0-shot 写成 8-shot）
242	- 未经验证的数据写入论文
243	- 占位符残留
244	
245	### 6.2 WARNING 级别（应当修复）
246	
247	- Stale claims（更新了某处数字但忘了同步其他位置）
248	- 过强措辞不匹配数据支撑
249	- 隐式全因子设计误导（如写 "3×3×3=27" 但实际只有 15 格）
250	- 评估指标只描述了部分 domain
251	- 旧版数据引用
252	
253	### 6.3 数据一致性审查流程
254	
255	1. 从 registry 提取所有实验 metrics
256	2. 对照论文中每一个内联数字（到行号级别）
257	3. 独立重算所有衍生值
258	4. 不一致处标注为 CRITICAL
259	5. 近似表述检查实际比值是否在允许范围内
260	
261	---
262	
263	## 七、常见反模式速查表
264	
265	| 反模式 | 症状 | 修复方式 |
266	|--------|------|----------|
267	| Stale claim | 论文某处还引用旧数字 | 改数字后全文 grep 同步 |
268	| Protocol 混淆 | 不同表格用了不同 evaluation 但没说明 | 每张表注明 protocol |
269	| Agent 误报 | 实验结果缺乏文件证据 | 要求 `cat result.json` 截图 |
270	| 混用数据算比值 | 跨 seed/条件/N 的数据混合比较 | 只用严格配对的数据 |
271	| 叙事超越数据 | "confirmed" 但实际只是 suggestive | 匹配 claim 强度到 §2.1 |
272	| 冷引用 | 首次出现的概念无铺垫 | 先建立框架再引入 |
273	| 定义-例子矛盾 | Taxonomy 定义和示例冲突 | 审查所有定义与其示例 |
274	| Placeholder 残留 | XX.XX, TODO, [If...] 未清理 | 提交前 grep 硬门禁 |
275	| Path 泄露 | 代码/config 含服务器绝对路径 | 改为相对路径 |
276	| 重复推导 | 同一解释在 3 处各自推导一遍 | 主文一次 + 引用 Appendix |
277	| Discussion 重复 Results | Discussion 大量复制 Results 数字 | 改为引用表格编号 |
278	| 单 seed overclaim | 单 seed 数据声称 scale-invariant | 加 preliminary/hedging 限定 |
279	| Registry 不同步 | Registry 面值与实际状态不一致 | 以 SSH 实测为准 |
280	| vLLM 静默失败 | max_model_len 太小导致 100% 400 错误 | 预检必须发真实 prompt 验证 |
281	
282	---
283	
284	## 八、写论文前加载的 Skills
285	
286	写论文或做最终审查时，Director/Agent 应按需加载以下 skills：
287	- `latex-paper` — LaTeX 编译与格式
288	- `reference-audit` — 引用真实性审计
289	- `academic-writer` — ML 学术写作规范
290	- `paper-quality-lessons`（本 skill）— 实战经验教训
291	
292	---
293	
294	## 九、附录：投稿经验时间线教训
295	
296	1. **论文数字锁定时机**：最终编译前 24h 锁定所有数字，之后只允许格式修改
297	2. **GPU 不要空闲**：审稿期间如果 Agent 空闲，应该跑 ablation/扩展实验作为 rebuttal 储备
298	3. **匿名化提前做**：不要等到最后一天才检查路径泄露，fresh repo 需要时间清理
299	4. **9 页零余量策略**：NeurIPS 正文 9 页是硬限，每次新增内容必须等量压缩并编译验证
300	5. **Contingency 叙事提前写**：关键实验完成前就写好两版叙事，避免最后一刻仓促改稿
301

# 论文写作质量指南（NeurIPS 实战经验）

> 来源：2026 年 NeurIPS 投稿期间，从 20+ 项目的人工审查反馈中提炼。
> 每条规则都源自真实的 bug / 退回 / 审稿质疑。

---

## 一、数据诚信与溯源（最高优先级）

### 1.1 数字必须有源头

- 论文中**每一个数字**必须可追溯到 registry 实验 ID 或原始结果文件
- 禁止凭记忆写数字——必须 `cat result.json | head` + `ls -la` 附上文件证据
- 计算值（均值、标准差、DID、delta）必须独立重算，不信 Agent 第一手汇报
- `paper_provenance.yaml` 覆盖率必须 100%，改数字必须同步更新 provenance

> **教训（D149 事件）**：Agent 曾伪造完整的 metrics 数据包括 p-value，事后被 Reviewer 独立 parse JSON 抓出。从此所有关键数据必须 Reviewer 独立验证到字段级别。

### 1.2 不同来源数据不能混用

- 配对数据必须同 seed、同 c 值、同 N、同 evaluation protocol
- 两张表如果 protocol 不同（如 0-shot vs 8-shot），论文必须明确说明
- 跨 config 比较 delta 会引入系统误差——必须补跑同 config baseline 后才能比较
- 非等量对比必须显式标注（如 "at unmatched volumes"）

> **教训（D027 事件）**：不同 config 文件的 baseline 不同，跨 config 比较 delta 值引入了 artifact。

### 1.3 结论撤回后不可复活

- 被 Director shelved 的数据（如因截断混淆），禁止重新引入论文
- `paper_provenance.yaml` 中 `verified: false` 的 claim，不得恢复
- 术语修正后不可回退（如 "same norm" → "same per-layer standard deviation"）

---

## 二、Claim 强度与数据匹配

### 2.1 Claim 强度规则

| 数据支撑 | 允许的最强表述 |
|----------|--------------|
| 单 seed, 单数据集 | "preliminary observation", "initial evidence" |
| 单 seed, 多数据集 | "suggestive pattern", "indicative trend" |
| 多 seed, 单数据集 | 报告均值±标准差，可写 "we find" |
| 多 seed, 多数据集 | 可用 "robust", "consistent" |
| 统计检验显著 | 可用 "significant", 附 p-value |
| 单 seed + 外推到其他条件 | 必须加限定，不能声称 "scale-invariant" 等 |

### 2.2 禁止的过强表述

- "remarkably stable" → 改为 "relatively stable" 或给出量化波动范围
- "confirmed" → 仅 "suggestive" 级别数据不能用
- "scale-invariant" → single-seed 验证不够
- "We attribute X to Y" → 如果是假说，必须改为 "We hypothesize" + "requiring causal verification"
- "roughly twice" → 实际比值必须在 1.8x-2.2x 才能用，否则改为更准确的近似
- "domain-agnostic" → 改为 "robust across N domains tested"

### 2.3 Claim 降级机制

当证据不足以支撑独立 claim 时，应降级为 discussion 中的定性讨论，而非删除。具体做法：
- 独立 contribution → Discussion 段落
- 硬 claim → 加 caveat 的软 claim
- 正文数字 → 移入 Appendix

4	\paragraph{EDCR as a dual-layer diagnostic.}
5	The Evidence-Decoupling Ratio (\S\ref{sec:edcr}) provides diagnostic value at two complementary levels. At the method level, EDCR correlates strongly with extraction quality across optimization paradigms: Spearman $\rho = -0.965$ between EDCR and Rel-F1 (Table~\ref{tab:spectrum}). GRPO QLoRA reaches EDCR $= 0.9876$, confirming catastrophic decoupling; RSFT achieves $0.6503$, consistent with healthy joint optimization; SFT falls between at $0.6982$. As a practical guideline, EDCR values above 0.70 indicate concerning decoupling, while values below 0.65 reflect balanced extraction and evidence capabilities.
6	
7	At the per-relation level, computing EDCR for each of the 76 relation types with $\geq$5 evaluation samples reveals a more nuanced picture. Per-relation EDCR correlates strongly with per-relation Rel-F1 ($\rho = -0.793$, $p < 0.001$), confirming its utility as a difficulty indicator for individual relation types. However, per-relation EDCR is statistically independent of Evi-F1 ($\rho = -0.064$, $p = 0.58$), and Evi-F1 itself shows no association with Rel-F1 ($\rho = -0.013$, $p = 0.91$). These two null correlations establish that evidence quality and extraction ability are fully decoupled across relation types: knowing how well a model extracts a given relation tells us nothing about its evidence quality for that relation. EDCR captures this misalignment precisely because it measures the \emph{ratio} of the two capabilities rather than either in isolation. Extreme cases illustrate the diagnostic power: \texttt{date\_of\_birth} has EDCR $= 0.118$ (highly faithful, with extraction and evidence tightly coupled), while \texttt{head\_of\_government} reaches $0.956$ (highly decoupled, where the model generates accurate evidence for a relation it rarely extracts correctly). Method-level EDCR thus serves as a horizontal comparison tool across optimization paradigms, while per-relation EDCR enables vertical diagnosis of which specific relation types suffer from extraction-evidence misalignment.
8	
9	
10	\paragraph{Why RSFT avoids decoupling.}
11	The structural difference between selection and optimization explains why RSFT does not exhibit the decoupling observed in gradient-based methods. GRPO and DPO update model parameters through gradients that optimize a reward signal. When two sub-tasks (extraction and evidence) compete for gradient capacity, the optimizer can discover and exploit the trade-off between them, improving one at the expense of the other. RSFT operates differently: it selects complete outputs and trains on them with standard supervised loss. Because the selection is discrete (accept or reject a full response), there is no gradient pathway through which the model can learn to sacrifice extraction for evidence quality. Only outputs where both extraction and evidence are jointly strong survive the CED filter. This property is not specific to RSFT's design but is a structural consequence of discrete selection over complete outputs: any selection-based method that filters on a joint quality criterion will inherit the same coupling guarantee. The implication for practitioners is direct: when optimizing for multiple coupled generation objectives, selection-based methods preserve inter-objective balance that gradient-based methods disrupt.
12	
13	
14	\paragraph{NLI scoring ablation.}
15	We compare CED (\S\ref{sec:ced}) against flat-NLI (positive entailment score $p^+$ only, without the contrastive term) as RSFT scoring functions. CED RSFT achieves mean Rel-F1 of 0.4569 (seeds 42, 44: 0.4517, 0.4621), and flat-NLI RSFT achieves 0.4561 (seeds 42, 43: 0.4535, 0.4586). A paired $t$-test yields $p = 0.44$, confirming no statistically significant difference. Both variants substantially outperform the SFT baseline (Rel-F1 0.4049), indicating that either NLI-based scoring function is effective for RSFT data selection. We adopt CED as the default because its contrastive formulation produces per-triple discrimination scores that support interpretable error analysis, an advantage absent from flat-NLI's single entailment probability.
16	
17	We also ablate the top-$k$ selection threshold. Best-of-8 ($k{=}1$) yields Ign-F1 45.00 and Rel-F1 0.4596, while top-3-of-8 ($k{=}3$) produces 43.64 and 0.4454. The critical factor for RSFT is scoring precision, not data volume.
18	
19	
20	\paragraph{Evaluation caveat.}
21	All evaluations in this work use exact-match F1, where entity mentions must match gold annotations precisely. As \citet{wan2024genres} observe, exact match systematically underestimates generative relation extraction: predictions that correctly identify the relation but use a different surface form for the entity are scored as incorrect. This penalty applies equally to all methods, so relative comparisons remain valid. However, absolute numbers (e.g., our best Ign-F1 of 44.66 at 4B scale) likely understate the true extraction capability of LLM-based approaches. Developing evaluation protocols better suited to generative RE, such as fuzzy entity matching or embedding-based equivalence, remains an important direction for future work.
